messages:
michelle: onboarding new tenant 'helios' in ap-southeast-8. Need p5 + g5 capacity and stable egress IPs for early integration tests. Account: 987654321012. Can infra start quota requests?
raj: noted. Do you need p4d too or just p5/g5 for the initial sprint? How many concurrent nodes?
michelle: just p5 + g5 for now. target ~8 p5 nodes + 16 g5 nodes for stage testing. Will iterate later.
ben: FYI quota changes we need: Accelerator quotas (p5, g5), ENI/secondary IP increases, Elastic IP quota bump, and probably NAT gateway throughput. I'll open infra ticket + AWS case.
michelle: thanks. also worried about public IP count — can we reuse shared egress?
raj: shared egress pool for that org is exhausted. We'll need account-level EIP increases or set up a small NAT per AZ with reserved EIPs.
sre-lara: reminder: increasing ENI/secondary IPs has subnet/CIDR implications. We'll need a subnet plan with AZ assignments and expected secondary IP per instance.
michelle: AZs: ap-southeast-8a/b/c. Secondary IPs per node ~8. Expect one NAT per AZ. Quick calc: 3 AZs, 24 total nodes, ~192 secondary IPs. Elastic IPs: 3 NAT EIPs + 1 jump host = 4-6 range.
ben: opening ticket now. infra-bot will post case IDs. Also note cost: NAT gw + EIP + increased data egress could be ~$1k-2k/mo in staging. For prod this will scale.
raj: recommend a temporary soft-limit bump (30d) so they can smoke-test while we negotiate reserved capacity. That keeps latencies low.
michelle: good call. Please include a sample quota request payload I can track.
ben: done. infra-bot: created INFRA-9451 for account 987654321012 (quota requests).
ben: opened AWS Support case 2026-03-18-012345 (accelerator + ENI + EIP). Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home#/case/?caseId=2026-03-18-012345
aws-support-bot: AWS case 2026-03-18-012345 acknowledged. Initial response ETA ~72 hours.
raj: I'll attach a spreadsheet with exact counts and per-AZ breakdown to the infra ticket. Also lining up subnet expansion plan with networking.
sre-lara: once quotas approve we'll want a staged rollout: 1 AZ pilot, then proceed to full 3 AZs. Keep autoscaler limits conservative.
michelle: will coordinate finance for reserved/commit options. Thanks all — i'll post updates here when finance signs off and when we've test results.
infra-bot: AWS case 2026-03-18-012345 updated: awaiting quota approvals (estimated 48-96h).
